name: Wheat (ZW) Price Levels & Wheat/Corn Spread Analysis
description: Research study analyzing CBOT Wheat (ZW) futures absolute price levels with year-over-year comparison, 52-week range, and the Wheat/Corn (ZW-ZC) dollar spread with seasonality analysis. Includes summary metrics, price chart with YoY overlay, spread chart with MA and seasonal norms, monthly seasonal bar chart, and rolling spread vs seasonal norm.
source:
# =============================================================================
# Wheat (ZW) Price Levels & Wheat/Corn Spread Analysis
# - ZW continuous futures (primary), ZC via reference_futures
# - YoY comparison, 52-week range, 20-day MA
# - Wheat/Corn dollar spread and ratio with seasonality
# =============================================================================

# --- ZW Data (primary asset) ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
zw_close = cont.c

# --- ZC Data (reference futures - already provides continuous front-month series) ---
zc_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZC')()
zc_close = zc_ref.c

# --- ZW Metrics ---
zw_1yr_ago = zw_close >> 252
zw_yoy_pct = (zw_close - zw_1yr_ago) / zw_1yr_ago
zw_ma20 = ma(period=20)(zw_close)
zw_52wk_high = max(period=252)(zw_close)
zw_52wk_low = min(period=252)(zw_close)

# --- Wheat/Corn Spread ---
spread = zw_close - zc_close
ratio = zw_close / zc_close
spread_ma20 = ma(period=20)(spread)
spread_1yr_ago = spread >> 252
spread_52wk_high = max(period=252)(spread)
spread_52wk_low = min(period=252)(spread)

# --- Calendar Month for Seasonality ---
bar_ts = index()()
month_num = datetime_extract(component='month')(bar_ts)

# --- Seasonal Average Spread (expanding mean per month) ---
# Compute cumulative count and sum per month, reset each month occurrence
is_jan = month_of_year(month='January')()
is_feb = month_of_year(month='February')()
is_mar = month_of_year(month='March')()
is_apr = month_of_year(month='April')()
is_may = month_of_year(month='May')()
is_jun = month_of_year(month='June')()
is_jul = month_of_year(month='July')()
is_aug = month_of_year(month='August')()
is_sep = month_of_year(month='September')()
is_oct = month_of_year(month='October')()
is_nov = month_of_year(month='November')()
is_dec = month_of_year(month='December')()

# Isolate spread values per month (null elsewhere)
spread_jan = where(is_jan, spread)
spread_feb = where(is_feb, spread)
spread_mar = where(is_mar, spread)
spread_apr = where(is_apr, spread)
spread_may = where(is_may, spread)
spread_jun = where(is_jun, spread)
spread_jul = where(is_jul, spread)
spread_aug = where(is_aug, spread)
spread_sep = where(is_sep, spread)
spread_oct = where(is_oct, spread)
spread_nov = where(is_nov, spread)
spread_dec = where(is_dec, spread)

# Expanding mean per month (cumulative mean over all same-month observations)
avg_jan = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_jan)
avg_feb = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_feb)
avg_mar = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_mar)
avg_apr = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_apr)
avg_may = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_may)
avg_jun = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_jun)
avg_jul = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_jul)
avg_aug = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_aug)
avg_sep = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_sep)
avg_oct = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_oct)
avg_nov = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_nov)
avg_dec = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spread_dec)

# Current seasonal norm: pick the correct monthly average for current month
seasonal_norm = conditional_select(
    is_jan, avg_jan,
    is_feb, avg_feb,
    is_mar, avg_mar,
    is_apr, avg_apr,
    is_may, avg_may,
    is_jun, avg_jun,
    is_jul, avg_jul,
    is_aug, avg_aug,
    is_sep, avg_sep,
    is_oct, avg_oct,
    is_nov, avg_nov,
    is_dec, avg_dec,
    0
)

# Deviation of current spread from seasonal norm (%)
seasonal_dev_pct = (spread - seasonal_norm) / abs(seasonal_norm)

# --- X-axis index ---
idx = index()()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Wheat (ZW) & Wheat/Corn Spread Summary",
        row_size=2,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=["ZW Price", "Wheat/Corn Spread"],
        col_headers=["Current", "1 Yr Ago", "YoY Chg / 52wk Hi", "52wk Hi / 52wk Lo", "52wk Lo / Seasonal Dev"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="ZW Current", grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="ZW 1Yr Ago", grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="ZW YoY %", grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="ZW 52wk High", grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="ZW 52wk Low", grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Spread Current", grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Spread 1Yr Ago", grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Spread 52wk Hi", grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Spread 52wk Lo", grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Seasonal Dev %", grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary",
    order=0
)(zw_close, zw_1yr_ago, zw_yoy_pct, zw_52wk_high, zw_52wk_low, spread, spread_1yr_ago, spread_52wk_high, spread_52wk_low, seasonal_dev_pct)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: ZW Price Chart (close, 20d MA, 1yr ago dashed)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title="Wheat (ZW) Price with YoY Comparison",
    category="Wheat Price",
    y_axis_label="Price (cents/bushel)",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ZW Close", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="20-Day MA", color=Color.Cyan, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Price 1 Yr Ago", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(idx, zw_close, zw_ma20, zw_1yr_ago)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Wheat/Corn Spread Chart
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title="Wheat/Corn Spread (ZW − ZC) with YoY Comparison",
    category="Wheat/Corn Spread",
    y_axis_label="Spread (cents/bushel)",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Spread", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="20-Day MA", color=Color.Teal),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Spread 1 Yr Ago", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Stone, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=2
)(idx, spread, spread_ma20, spread_1yr_ago)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Monthly Seasonal Average Spread (bar chart Jan-Dec)
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title="Wheat/Corn Spread: Historical Monthly Seasonal Average",
    category="Seasonality",
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    x_axis_label="Month",
    y_axis_label="Avg Spread (cents/bushel)",
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Stone, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=3
)(values=seasonal_norm, label=month_num)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 5: Rolling Spread vs Seasonal Norm
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title="Wheat/Corn Spread vs Seasonal Norm",
    category="Seasonality",
    y_axis_label="Spread (cents/bushel)",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Actual Spread", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Seasonal Norm", color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Stone, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=4
)(idx, spread, seasonal_norm)
